answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 149115 Country: India Title: In our masjid the muezzin is not keeping dadhi (beard), whether he is correct & whether is the azan legal as per our Shariah. Question: In our masjid the muezzin is not keeping dadhi (beard), whether he is correct & whether is the azan legal as per our Shariah. Answer ID: 149115 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 688/580/H=6/1438) (1) It is haram to shave the beard. It is also unlawful and major sin to trim or get it trimmed less than one fist. Its detail is available in Fatawa Shami, Kitab al-Sawm. Ikhtilaf-e-Ummat and Sirat-e-Mustaqeem speaks about it in great detail and the summary is what we have written above. The person who shaves his beard or keeps it less than one fist he is fasiq (transgressor). (3) The adhan of a fasiq is makrooh though it shall not be repeated if he delivers it. ويكره اذان الفاسق ولا يعاد هكذا فى الذخيرة اهـ الفتاوى الهنديه ج 1 ص 54. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
